Results.ReviewText:
I purchased the Weber Spirit E-210 gas grill pre-assembled; however, I still needed to install the propane tank. I was initially confused by the instructions on how to install the tank. All my previous grills had the grill sitting on the floor and then secured; this one required the tank to be hung. Further the instructions and diagram did not match the design of my tank. Weber sent me a different instruction and diagram that was appropriate for my tank design. Installation was then easy but it is awkward to hang a heavy tank inside the cabinet. 

I am still getting used to the new grill. It runs much hotter than my old grill so I'm still working on a balance of "just right" rather than undercook or burn -- I'm narrowing in on the right settings. 

I did find that the design of my old grill brush did not work on this model. I looked up what Weber recommended (three sided grill brush) and purchased the Weber version; it works great.

All in all, so far so good and I'm pleased with the Weber Spirit E-210 Gas Grill.

Results.ReviewText: Better made than other grills I've had. The drippings tray iwell designed and good quality. The tank weight scale is very helpful. Easy lighting and solid, well made grates. I like the easy up/ easy down side shelves too.

Results.ReviewText: I Downsized from a large grill to the two burner spirit, also purchased the rotisserie.  I love the convenience of this grill and how quick it gets to the desired temperature. So far kabob’s chicken and veggies ,rotisserie chicken and Cornish hen were great. The only reason for 4stars is , the back of grill has flames across it, making the heat much higher in the back. Easy to clean and fuel level indicator are some of the reasons I’m Very satisfied with and love this grill.

I am enjoying this new Spirit E-210 Weber grill that we purchased recently. This grill is a two burner grill that suits our grilling needs quite well. It is easy to use and keep clean after each use.

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
